sources.facts: Exact title Light Rail 2.0; reversible with four holds. Metric outline 457 × 76 × 38 mm, 0.54 kg, FSC wood. Text lists depths 15, 20, 40 mm.
sources.notEstablished: The specification does not measure mouth width, lip radii, cord bore diameter or detailed cross-section; no wood species.

sources.tier: manufacturer original photograph; visually inspected at 1000 × 1000
sources.facts: Front photo shows one continuous long recess with closed rounded ends, rounded outer beam, two end cord entry regions and labels 40/20 upright and 15/40 inverted. No old-model face screw holes visible.
sources.notEstablished: Reverse and end-on measured profile absent. The two 40 mm labels are nominal, not proof of an exact 40 mm Y thickness.

sources.facts: The shared instructions explicitly classify Light Rails and Rock Rings as suspended devices.
sources.notEstablished: Not a dimensioned or revision-specific Light Rail 2.0 drawing; no hidden passage path.

sources.facts: Exact 2.0 title and 18 × 3 × 1.5 in dimensions. Listed depths 40,26,19,15 mm disagree with the manufacturer photograph and current text.
sources.notEstablished: No corroborating drawing establishes the claimed 26 mm contact.

conflicts.conflict: REI lists 40/26/19/15 while current manufacturer text and picture show 40/20/40/15.
conflicts.ruling: Use the currently pictured manufacturer revision and the visible labels. Preserve retailer conflict, do not invent a 26 mm fifth contact.

conflicts.conflict: 40 mm nominal jug versus body thickness 38 mm.
conflicts.ruling: Keep published 38 mm overall thickness and treat 40 as manufacturer nominal grip depth. Do not enlarge the whole asset to reconcile a label.

conflicts.conflict: 15 mm is paired with 0.71 inch in manufacturer text, which is arithmetically inconsistent.
conflicts.ruling: Use explicit metric 15 mm confirmed by photograph; do not use the parenthetical inch figure.
